fields.title: Real class column
fields.description: The column from the second input table that contains the real class values for each row.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Predicted class column
fields.description: The column from the second input table that contains the predicted class values for each row.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Number of iterations
fields.description: The number of iterations the loop should be run, i.e., the number of models to be learned.

fields.title: Use seed for random numbers
fields.description:
Check this option if you want to use a fixed seed for generating random numbers. This ensures
that for the same input data always the same result is produced in each iteration.

fields.title: Seed
fields.description: Enter the seed for the random number generator here.
